notes.title: Achievements Progress Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! As mentioned, [u]achievements will be coming soon[/u] to CUBEMATRIX. However, [b]due to University finals and the production of our second game with the new Unity Team, I have yet to be able to implement them fully.[/b]

I have been able to integrate the achievement system in Unity and [b]plan to create them after finals and send them out as a major update.[/b] Thank you all for your patience and I hope to bring you all the content soon!

notes.title: What's the next step for Forged Vault Games?
notes.content:
[b]What will happen with CUBEMATRIX?[/b] 🟥: I plan to send out updates to my stand-alone game throughout the years based on the suggestions I have received from the community!

[b]Any future games to come?[/b] 👾: Although I will continue to work on CUBEMATRIX, I have formed a team to work on our next project: A single-player story-driven 2D game! Our game is in the beginning stages and will take approximately 3 - 5 years to come out.

[b]How can I know more information about CUBEMATRIX and the new game being made?[/b] 💁‍♂️:

[u]Steam Group[/u] 🤝: A recent Forged Vault Games Steam group on Steam was created! There you can find the latest news about our current and future games.

[u]YouTube[/u] 🎞️: https://www.youtube.com/@forgedvaultgames/featured


[u]Instagram[/u] 📱: https://www.instagram.com/forged_vault_games/?hl=en
